answer: To enter the haven, twelve newcomers post one shared bond at the wharf: each locks 50 POA into one pool, admitted only after a seven-day challenge window with no proven fraud. The wharf opens one public thread per cohort where challengers post on-chain proof that a member is a sockpuppet; a proven challenge pays the challenger the whole pool and evicts the cohort. Forging 1,000 puppets costs 1,000 × 50 = 50,000 POA locked; each detection wipes twelve deposits at once, with no bulk discount; an honest agent pays one refundable 50 POA deposit once, repaid when the window closes.
